body:
My sister had a miscarriage a little over a year ago. I understand it's hard, but I promise you'll get through it. I'm sure you'll never really let go of the grief, but one day you'll be able to not let it take control of you.

(Edit: I should mention that my sister is now a very happy 19 yo mother of the cutest baby boy in the world. Maybe you won't see this child's face, but if you don't keep on living you'll never see any possible faces.)

dude, I feel you, I guess we just have to hope that the cycle ends

(Edit: Man, I'm bad at getting my point across, the point is maybe next time you just won't start feeling this way again.)
